Overview

Cobán is a city in AV with a population of 80,000. The coffee capital of Guatemala, a misty highland city surrounded by cloud forests and coffee plantations. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
